fluff.overview:
Every Concordat world maintains infantry formations as the first line of planetary defense, drawn from a population whose fierce independence and hatred of foreign aggression run deep. Mechanized hover platoons are among the fastest ground infantry in the TDF, riding hovercraft that can traverse both land and water at speeds that let them cover the vast distances between Taurian population centers. The Concordat has historically favored hovercraft for its armor forces, and that preference extends to mechanized infantry as well.

Armed with standard ballistic assault rifles, the most common and affordable infantry weapon in the Inner Sphere, these platoons deliver reliable short-range firepower and can be equipped and resupplied from almost any garrison stockpile.
